brief.headline: Cinven acquires Theramex for €2.6bn as Carlyle and PAI secure exit
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Cinven has agreed to acquire women's healthcare specialist Theramex from Carlyle and PAI Partners in a transaction valued at approximately €2.6bn, almost double the €1.4bn paid by the sellers four years earlier, according to a report by the Financial Times.
Private Credit: Blackstone has closed on €13bn (£10.9bn) of investable capital for its European direct lending strategy, as more investors look to private credit on the continent.
Hotels & Hospitality: The buyer was an affiliate of Host Hotels & Resorts.

Fed & Rates: In our latest episode of The Insight podcast, Wayne Dahl, co-Portfolio Manager of Oaktree’s Global Credit strategy, discusses what’s behind the rise in rates, how it’s reshaping the opportunity set in credit markets and where to find value today.
Investor Outlook: Goldman Sachs President and COO John Waldron says clients have a cautiously optimistic outlook and the surge in M&A is a sign of that confidence.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,568.92 (up 0.4% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 16.6, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.95% (up 4 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.32 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.32%, near long-run norms (down 8 bps on the prior reading).

items.title: Blackstone lands €13bn for European direct lending
